title: Support customer registration number as e-document party identifier for DE
summary: German customers can now use their registration number as the buyer identifier on outgoing e-invoices when no VAT ID or GLN is available.
key_points: Adds a toggle on the customer record to enable registration number use in e-documents
Registration number is written as buyer legal registration in PEPPOL BIS, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats
Extends existing functionality already available for company and vendor e-documents
Only applies when the flag is enabled and VAT ID/GLN are unavailable
Includes new test cases for all three e-document formats
quote: writes the customer's Registration No. as the buyer legal registration (BT-47) in PEPPOL BIS, XRechnung and ZUGFeRD
